issue.body:
Can timeout and scheduling changes recover complete positive control pairs without repairing tasks? Follow-up to #28; investigation remains open.

**Completed:** four existing Matchms exports now have positive nop/oracle pairs, preserved regression tests and clean oracle commands; all 40 task files are unchanged. These are completed controls, not new exports. [Results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/188091eb/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json).

**Scanpy:** replaying all 16 recorded bootstrap commands reproduced their original exit codes, including a failure that stops the generated Dockerfile. No command or dependency repairs were made. Smoke/fresh-image checks remain false, so this is reconstruction evidence, not environment readiness or original-image equivalence. The unchanged PR4389 export is now submitted for nop/oracle controls at 300 versus 1,200 verifier seconds. [Replay evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/65cfc8b5/experiments/29-runtime-limits/scanpy-recorded-result-001.json) · [Control protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/65cfc8b5/experiments/29-runtime-limits/scanpy-controls-protocol.md).

**Remaining:** verify the Scanpy controls and cleanup; assess faithful OHIF reconstruction (its Docker build excludes a required workspace); verify the submitted OpenMS checkout comparison; checkpoint MMseqs2’s bootstrap comparison and model allowance. The OpenMS 60/300-second acquisition-only comparison is submitted; results are pending. Longer verifier limits cannot resolve installation or checkout failures.

**Budget and retention:** eight completed jobs used 1.06233 allocated CPU-hours. The submitted Scanpy controls and OpenMS acquisition comparison allow at most 12 more within the existing 32-hour ceiling, on reserved capacity. Zero model calls. One owned Scanpy image remains for these controls and will be removed after archive readback. Raw Matchms evidence remains private. No pipeline promoted. Detailed logs and execution updates remain in comments.

comment_body:
🤖 Submitted the separately checkpointed OpenMS acquisition-only comparison, `biotasks29-openms-checkout-001`, while the Scanpy controls continue. [Protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8d081003/experiments/29-runtime-limits/openms-checkout-protocol.md).

Both arms use frozen commit `5edf83948816aee51225949dd0e613bd40f69c47`, fresh original-controller containers at 1 CPU/4 GiB, and the pinned clone/fetch logic. The baseline keeps checkout at 60 seconds; the candidate sets only checkout to 300. Each stops before repository installation, bootstrap, PR listing or model calls. Baseline-first cache/timing effects and mutable system packages remain explicit limitations; the result can establish only acquisition success or failure.

One existing reserved TRC job, 2 allocated CPUs/8 GiB/30 GiB, 4,200-second outer bound (2.3334 CPU-hours maximum). The cumulative gate reserves the active Scanpy controls’ entire 9.6667-hour maximum plus 1.06233 measured hours, staying below #29’s existing 32-hour ceiling. No new capacity or model spending. All owned checkout containers are stopped before archive copying and removed before the next arm. Results and archive readback remain pending.
